request: Round 45, twenty-second build (incremental on the nineteenth): MoltBrowser creates WebRTC-Aec3TransparentModeHmm/Disabled before Chromium's field trial testing config (which turns the HMM transparent mode on), so the echo canceller uses its own default transparent mode; --force-fieldtrials still wins. The twenty-first run, with that trial forced, gave 75% file, 84% noloop (media failures 4-5 to 1), 73% with the speakers (no regression).
